subject: gk
question: Instrumentalist Shiv Kumar Sharma is related to:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Santoor**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Santoor -

 
 
• It is an Indian instrument that is trapezoidal in shape.
 
• Traditional instrument of Jammu and Kashmir.
 
• Other proponents are Ulhas Bapat and Rahul Sharma.
 
 
 
• Pandit Shiv Kumar Sharma -
 
 
• He was a Santoor player and a music composer.
 
• Awarded with Sangeet Natak Akademi Award, Padma Shri, Padma Bhushan.
 
• He passed away recently on May 10th,2022.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Been : **

 
 
• A traditional wind instrument used primarily by snake charmers in India, consisting of a gourd with two pipes, producing a unique and continuous melody.
 
 
 
• **Tabla**:
 
 
• A pair of hand-played Indian drums, comprising a small right-hand drum (dayan) and a larger left-hand drum (bayan), used in classical, popular, and devotional music to provide rhythmic accompaniment.
 
 
 
• **Piano: **
 
 
• A versatile and widely-used keyboard instrument where strings are struck by hammers, capable of producing a wide range of dynamics and timbres, fundamental to both solo and ensemble performances in Western music.
